items.title: Solana’s V1 upgrade makes transactions 3.3x bigger – What does it mean for SOL?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The V1 upgrade enhances transaction capacity, potentially increasing network efficiency and attracting more users and developers to the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: Solana nearly froze as a single routing error took 29% of the network stake offline
items.whyYouShouldCare: The recent network freeze due to a routing error highlights vulnerabilities in Solana's infrastructure, which could impact user confidence and overall network reliability.

items.title: Solana lender Kamino taps fintech veteran Michael Weisz as CEO for massive U.S. expansion
items.whyYouShouldCare: Kamino's leadership change signals a strategic push into the U.S. market, which could enhance liquidity and broaden Solana's lending ecosystem.
